definitions.ask: Which keys should the new Note link and Task link rows use?
definitions.why: L reads as link on the always-present row; K sits beside it and dodges t

choices.label: L copies the note link, K the task link; home-row neighbors, clear of your t template
W copies the note link (wikilink), L the task link, the more frequent row
L copies the note link, B the task link (Obsidian calls it a block link)
